name: tilttek/exchange-bundle
description: tilttek/exchange in Symfony: members redeem rewards, give points and trade items, kept in the database with forms, safeguards and expiry.

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the exchanges' tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's exchanges with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that expire the reservations and the offers and show the journal of transfers
suggest.symfony/form: For the forms that reserve a reward, give points and make an offer
suggest.tilttek/points-bundle: For the Points and Currencies services the exchanges spend, give and refund through; an application may register its own instead
